tweetText: US health agencies are testing AI models from OpenAI and Anthropic. This program aims to see how these tools can improve public health services. via AI News

OpenAI shared lessons learned from deploying AI models that run for long periods. These models introduce new safety risks that require better safeguards. via OpenAI News
Anthropic reached a $1.5 billion settlement regarding copyright use. This sets a major precedent for how AI models are trained on protected works. via TechCrunch AI
